description: Will's real 08-24 incident (T64 diagnosis A, BUG 1). He typed 'No my program wraps up sept 7th' against BLOCK 1 ('ROAD TO 315'), whose own text declares it runs Aug 17 to Sep 5 (explicit end date, matching its real Week 3 header 'Aug 31 to Sep 5, heavy week'). Joe's own reply named Sep 5 in the same breath as accepting Will's Sep 7, and nothing reconciled the two. The app then stored Sep 7 on the ATHLETE row with no tie to Block 1 at all, so it silently survived into Block 2 (applied 2026-09-09) — which is what let a wrong 'wraps up' date leak into a program it was never about.
